aboutPage.heroDescription: Systematic solution of social problems through supporting effective projects that truly change people's lives
aboutPage.missionP1: Obstacles don't stop you. They forge you. The creators of Good Foundation is for those who don't give up. For those who fight. For those who win.
aboutPage.missionP2: We're not about pity. We're about results. Children's sports for the disabled isn't a limitation—it's a challenge. Helping mothers isn't weakness—it's strength. Every project is a step toward victory.
aboutPage.missionP3: You either act or you give up. We choose to act. Join us. Become part of a movement that changes the game.
aboutPage.valuesDescription: Values are the foundation of our work. They define every step we take, every decision we make, and every project we support.
aboutPage.value1Text: We openly publish all reports on spending and project results. Every donor can see where their funds are directed and what result was achieved. We believe that transparency is the foundation of trust.
aboutPage.value2Text: We don't just talk—we act. Every project is aimed at a specific result. We don't look for excuses, we look for solutions. Every donation turns into real help for those who need it.
aboutPage.value3Text: We focus on projects that create sustainable changes in society. We don't look for quick results but invest in solutions that will work for years and influence future generations.
aboutPage.value4Text: We believe in the power of mutual aid. When you extend a helping hand, you become part of a community that changes lives. We support those in difficult situations and create conditions for them to move forward.
aboutPage.timelineDescription: Our plans for the coming years. We are building a future where every disabled child has the opportunity to play sports, and every mother receives support.
aboutPage.roadmap2025Desc: Foundation registration, website launch, opening of the first sports section for disabled children and creation of a mothers support center
aboutPage.roadmap2026Desc: Opening 3-5 sports sections in different cities, development of mothers support center, launch of inclusive programs
aboutPage.roadmap2027Desc: Expanding activities to regional level, creating a network of partnerships, launching summer sports camps
aboutPage.roadmap2028Desc: Expansion to federal level, creation of educational programs for coaches, development of volunteer movement
aboutPage.roadmap2029Desc: Creating a sustainable support ecosystem, developing innovative approaches, international cooperation
aboutPage.achievementsDescription: We focus on specific areas that truly change people's lives and create sustainable change.
aboutPage.achievement1Text: Creating sports sections and programs for children with disabilities, giving them the opportunity to develop, gain confidence and achieve results.
aboutPage.achievement2Title: Support for mothers with disabled children
aboutPage.achievement2Text: Supporting mothers who are left alone with adult disabled children, providing counseling, psychological help and temporary care.
aboutPage.achievement3Text: Developing inclusive programs that help people with disabilities integrate into society and lead full lives.
aboutPage.achievement4Text: Creating a support system for those who find themselves in difficult life situations, helping them move forward and not give up.
aboutPage.teamDescription: Our team consists of experienced specialists in social work, project management, and effectiveness evaluation.
aboutPage.member1Bio: More than 15 years of experience in managing social projects. Expert in strategic planning.
aboutPage.member2Bio: Specialist in development and implementation of educational and social programs.
aboutPage.member3Bio: Experienced project manager with focus on environmental initiatives.
aboutPage.member4Bio: Ensures transparency and efficiency of fund usage.
aboutPage.member5Bio: Develops partnerships and communications with donors and partners.
aboutPage.member6Bio: Conducts monitoring and evaluation of project effectiveness.
aboutPage.impactP1: We don't just finance projects — we create an ecosystem of support that helps organizations grow, develop, and achieve maximum impact on society.
aboutPage.impactP2: Our work is based on principles of transparency, professionalism, and long-term impact. We believe that a systematic approach to solving social problems can change the world for the better.
aboutPage.founderP1: Three years ago, my life was divided into 'before' and 'after'. For 37 years, I was an independent, purposeful, active, athletic, and very sociable person. I grew up in Altai in an ordinary family, joined the army at 18, and stayed on contract service. I served for six years in the Far East, which gave me serious resilience and my life motto: protect the weak, fear nothing, and achieve your goals.
aboutPage.founderP2: In 2013, I had a dream to attend the opening of the Olympic Games in Sochi. Without hesitation, I bought tickets and went there. About a week after arriving in Sochi, I found work as a host at the Vegas disco bar at the Yuzhnoye Vzmorye sanatorium, and simultaneously applied to join the Olympic Games organizing committee, where I was later accepted as head of the 'Spectator at the venue' program. My dream came true, and my horizons expanded greatly. I gained invaluable experience there and am very grateful to fate for the opportunity to experience and participate in organizing our country's largest project.
aboutPage.founderP3: Two years later, I launched my own project and started doing business. Three years later, my project called '#Yuzhnaya Pena' was already in three cities. Unfortunately, the coronavirus made its adjustments. After that, I didn't abandon my project and started getting back on my feet, but unfortunately, I got into an accident and received a very serious injury - a fracture of the cervical vertebrae.
aboutPage.founderP4: Life gave me a second chance. I won't hide it - I had to go through many difficulties I never suspected existed. But God gifted me with a warrior's character, and I don't give up, I continue to fight to this day. Unfortunately, for some, this is an unequal battle, because over three years I was left literally alone, and every day is a new small battle with myself.
aboutPage.founderP5: Someone extended a hand to me at a very difficult moment in my life, when I ran out of strength and resources to fight. This moment in my life became a turning point. I understand that if no one had extended a hand, if no one had helped, I probably would have given up too. But thanks to the fact that someone extended a hand to me, I continue to fight every day.
aboutPage.founderP6: If you're seeing this presentation now, you're one of those I'm calling on not to stand aside. I decided to dedicate my life to explaining to people that in our country there are many who need help and support. If you have the opportunity to respond in some way and not remain indifferent, you can save someone's life, motivate someone to keep moving forward, to fight, not to give up.
aboutPage.founderP7: Because no one is immune, and we can all find ourselves in my place. When you're left alone facing a situation stronger than you. And only God can help you. But after everything, I know that God is in each of us - we just need to extend a hand to those who need it!
aboutPage.founderQuote: I call us creators of good! Are you with us?! Let's create good together!
aboutPage.ctaDescription: Together we can create more good and help more people. Join us as a donor, partner, or volunteer.

cookiesPage.section2Content2: Functional cookies — remember your preferences (language, region) to improve Platform operation.
cookiesPage.section2Content3: Analytical cookies — help us understand how users interact with the Platform to improve it.
cookiesPage.section2Content4: Marketing cookies — used to show relevant information (only with your consent).

helpCenterPage.heroDescription: Find answers to frequently asked questions
helpCenterPage.category1Q1: How do I register on the platform?
helpCenterPage.category1A1: To register, click the "Join" button in the top right corner of the site. You can register with email and password, or use Google sign-in. After registration, you will be offered a brief tutorial to help you get familiar with the platform.
helpCenterPage.category1Q2: Do I need to register to make donations?
helpCenterPage.category1A2: No, you can make a donation without registration. However, registered users get access to a personal account where they can track their donations, view reports and manage subscriptions.
helpCenterPage.category1A3: A personal account is your personal space on the platform where you can manage your profile, view donation history, set up recurring payments, track achievements and get personalized project recommendations.
helpCenterPage.category1Q4: How do I recover access to my account?
helpCenterPage.category1A4: If you forgot your password, click "Forgot password?" on the login page. A recovery link will be sent to your email. If you have access issues, contact our support service.
helpCenterPage.category2Q1: How do I make a donation?
helpCenterPage.category2A1: Select a project you're interested in on the main page or in the "Programs" section. Click the "Support project" button, specify the donation amount and choose a payment method. You can make a one-time donation or set up recurring payments (subscription).
helpCenterPage.category2A2: We accept payments by Visa, MasterCard, MIR bank cards, as well as through electronic wallets. All payments are processed through secure payment systems using SSL encryption.
helpCenterPage.category2A3: Yes, payment security is our priority. All transactions are processed through certified payment systems using modern encryption. We do not store your bank card data. All information is transmitted through secure communication channels.
helpCenterPage.category2Q4: Can I make an anonymous donation?
helpCenterPage.category2A4: Yes, when making a donation, you can select the "Anonymous donation" option. In this case, your name will not be displayed in the project's donor list.
helpCenterPage.category2Q5: How do I set up a recurring donation?
helpCenterPage.category2A5: When selecting the donation amount, check the "Recurring donation" option and choose the frequency (monthly, quarterly, annually). Recurring donations can be managed in the "Subscriptions" section of your personal account.
helpCenterPage.category2Q6: Can I cancel or change a recurring donation?
helpCenterPage.category2A6: Yes, you can cancel, pause or change the amount of a recurring donation at any time in the "Subscriptions" section of your personal account. Changes will take effect from the next payment.
helpCenterPage.category2Q7: Is a document issued for tax deduction?
helpCenterPage.category2A7: Yes, for all donations we issue official documents that can be used to obtain a tax deduction. Documents are available for download in the "Reports" section of your personal account.
helpCenterPage.category2Q8: What is the minimum donation amount?
helpCenterPage.category2A8: The minimum donation amount is 100 rubles. You can donate any amount from 100 rubles and above.
helpCenterPage.category2Q9: What happens to the donation after payment?
helpCenterPage.category2A9: After successful payment, funds are credited to the project's special account. We regularly transfer collected funds to project implementing organizations. You can track the use of funds through reports in your personal account.
helpCenterPage.category3Q1: How do I choose a project to support?
helpCenterPage.category3A1: All active projects are presented on the main page and in the "Programs" section. You can filter them by category (education, healthcare, ecology, etc.), by collection amount or by popularity. Each project contains a detailed description, goals, budget and implementation reports.
helpCenterPage.category3Q2: How do I track the use of my donations?
helpCenterPage.category3A2: In your personal account in the "Reports" section, you can view detailed reports on the implementation of projects you donated to. Reports include information on how funds were used, what results were achieved, and implementation photos.
helpCenterPage.category3A3: Reports are published regularly depending on the project implementation stage. Usually reports are published monthly or upon completion of key project stages. You will receive a notification about a new report by email.
helpCenterPage.category3Q4: Can I propose my own project?
helpCenterPage.category3A4: Yes, we accept applications for project placement. To do this, fill out the form in the "Contacts" section or email us. Our team will review your application and contact you to discuss details.
helpCenterPage.category3A5: All projects undergo thorough verification before being placed on the platform. We check the legal status of organizations, their work experience, transparency of financial reporting and compliance of stated goals with real needs.
helpCenterPage.category4Q1: How do I set up my profile?
helpCenterPage.category4A1: In your personal account, go to the "My Profile" section where you can upload a profile photo, specify your name, add a description and configure your profile visibility for other users.
helpCenterPage.category4A2: Achievements are a gamification system that marks your activity on the platform. You receive achievements for various actions: first donation, recurring donations, participation in a certain number of projects, etc.
helpCenterPage.category4A3: The rating reflects your contribution to charity on the platform. It is calculated based on donation amount, number of supported projects, payment regularity and other factors. The rating is displayed in your profile and in the general donor rating.
helpCenterPage.category4A4: Yes, in profile settings you can choose the privacy level: public profile, profile only for friends or completely private profile.
helpCenterPage.category4Q5: How do I export donation data?
helpCenterPage.category4A5: In the "Reports" section, you can export data about all your donations in PDF or Excel format. This is convenient for keeping personal records or providing documents to the tax service.
helpCenterPage.category5A1: AliusAI is an intelligent assistant created based on artificial intelligence that helps you find the information you need about projects, answer questions about the platform and get personalized charity recommendations.
helpCenterPage.category5A2: AliusAI is available through the button in the top right corner of the site or through the "AliusAI" section in your personal account. Simply ask a question in the chat, and the assistant will provide you with information or recommendations.
helpCenterPage.category5A3: AliusAI is in test mode and constantly learning. It provides information based on platform data, but always check important information yourself. We are constantly improving answer accuracy.
helpCenterPage.category5Q4: Is my conversation with AliusAI private?
helpCenterPage.category5A4: Yes, your conversations with AliusAI are private. We use conversation data only to improve the service quality, and we do not share your conversations with third parties without your consent.
helpCenterPage.category5Q5: Can AliusAI help choose a project?
helpCenterPage.category5A5: Yes, AliusAI can analyze your interests and donation history to suggest projects that might interest you. Simply describe what interests you, and the assistant will suggest suitable options.
helpCenterPage.category5Q6: When will AliusAI be fully available?
helpCenterPage.category5A6: AliusAI is in active development. We plan to launch the full version in the coming months. Follow updates in the "Release Notes" section.
helpCenterPage.category6Q1: What are subscriptions on the platform?
helpCenterPage.category6A1: Subscriptions are paid plans that provide additional features: extended access to AliusAI, priority support, extended reports and exclusive features. Subscriptions also include regular donations to projects.
helpCenterPage.category6A2: Three plans are available: Basic (299₽/month), Premium (799₽/month) and Maximum (1499₽/month). Each plan includes different features and capabilities. Details can be viewed in the "Subscriptions" section of your personal account.
helpCenterPage.category6A3: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time in the "Subscriptions" section of your personal account. Cancellation will take effect at the end of the current paid period.
helpCenterPage.category6Q4: What happens when I cancel my subscription?
helpCenterPage.category6A4: After canceling your subscription, you retain access to plan features until the end of the paid period. After that, your account will switch to the free plan, but you will retain access to basic platform features.
helpCenterPage.category6Q5: Can I change my subscription plan?
helpCenterPage.category6A5: Yes, you can switch to another plan at any time in the "Subscriptions" section. When switching to a more expensive plan, the difference will be charged proportionally. When switching to a cheaper plan, the difference will be credited to the next period.
helpCenterPage.category7A1: The platform works in all modern browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge and their mobile versions. It is recommended to use the latest browser versions for best performance.
helpCenterPage.category7A2: Currently, the platform is available through a mobile browser with responsive design. A mobile app is in development and will be available soon.
helpCenterPage.category7Q3: What should I do if the site doesn't load?
helpCenterPage.category7A3: Check your internet connection, clear your browser cache or try opening the site in incognito mode. If the problem persists, contact our support service.
helpCenterPage.category7A4: In your personal account settings, you can configure email and browser notifications. Choose which events you want to receive notifications about: new reports, project updates, achievements, etc.
helpCenterPage.category7Q5: How do I change the interface language?
helpCenterPage.category7A5: The interface language is determined automatically based on your domain or browser settings. Currently, Russian and English are available.
helpCenterPage.category8A1: We use modern encryption methods to protect your data. All personal data is stored on secure servers with limited access. We never share your data with third parties without your consent.
helpCenterPage.category8A2: We collect only the information necessary for the platform to work: name, email, payment data (processed by payment systems), donation history. Details are described in our Privacy Policy.
helpCenterPage.category8A3: Yes, you can delete your account in profile settings. After deletion, all your personal data will be deleted, but donation information (without personal data) may be retained for financial reporting.
helpCenterPage.category8Q4: What should I do if I suspect fraud?
helpCenterPage.category8A4: If you notice suspicious activity or suspect fraud, contact our support service immediately. We take security seriously and investigate all such cases.

reportData.report1Summary: Thanks to your support, we were able to provide clean water to 50 families in remote areas of Nepal.
reportData.report1Quote: Thank you for being with us — together we achieved 100% of our goal!
reportData.report1FullText:
# Project Implementation Report "Water for Nepal"

## Introduction

As part of the "Water for Nepal" project, we successfully implemented a program to provide access to clean drinking water for residents of remote areas of Nepal.

## Key Achievements

- Provided clean water to 50 families (more than 250 people)
- Installed 15 water access points
- Conducted hygiene training seminars for local residents
- Created a support and maintenance system for water points

## Financial Report

- Total funds raised: 1,500,000 ₽
- Spent on project: 1,450,000 ₽
- Remaining funds directed to project development: 50,000 ₽

## Results

Thanks to your support, we were able to significantly improve the quality of life for people in remote areas. Access to clean water reduced disease rates and improved sanitary conditions in the region.

## Gratitude

Thank you to all donors for their contribution to the implementation of this project. Your support helps change people's lives for the better!
reportData.report2Summary: Your donations helped provide medical assistance to 100 families in need.
reportData.report2Quote: Your support has changed people's lives for the better.
reportData.report2FullText:
# Medical Assistance Report

## Introduction

The project aims to provide medical assistance to families in need who do not have access to quality medical care.

## Key Achievements

- Medical assistance provided to 100 families
- 250 consultations with doctors conducted
- More than 500 prescription medications issued
- Preventive examinations organized for children and adults

## Financial Report

- Total funds raised: 2,000,000 ₽
- Spent on medical services: 1,850,000 ₽
- Spent on medications: 120,000 ₽
- Remaining: 30,000 ₽

## Results

The project significantly improved access to medical care for families in need. Many people received timely treatment and were able to improve their health.

## Gratitude

Your support has changed people's lives for the better. Thank you for your participation in this important project!
